# Saltwater Studio

Saltwater Studio is a remote AI agency founded in 2025 by Travis Abadie in Destin, Florida, building AI automation and AI-search presence for local businesses nationwide.

Not affiliated with Studio Saltwater, Saltwater Design Studio, or Saltwatr Studios. The Saltwater Studio described here is the one at saltwaterstudio.xyz, founded by Travis Abadie in Destin, Florida.

## Offers

- AI Visibility Audit — $50 flat through Oct 31, 2026 (regularly $150), delivered within 72 hours, fully async: https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#audit
- AI Search Optimization Sprint (implements the audit — schema, answer-first restructuring, entity fixes, Google Business Profile; quote-based): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#sprint
- AI-Managed Presence (ongoing monthly management of search and AI presence; quote-based): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#retainer
- Custom AI Systems (automations, agents, integrations; quote-based): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#custom
